bp3-base.prm:
# Functional output regression only; coarse broad profile, not production BP3.
include $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/bp3/bp3_150x50_filter20.prm
set Resume computation = false
set End time = 600
set Maximum time step = 100
set Maximum first time step = 100
subsection Mesh refinement
  set Initial global refinement = 0
  set Initial adaptive refinement = 0
  subsection BP3 saved mesh
    set Target cells file = $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/fixtures/target_cells.txt
  end
end
subsection Phase field model
  set Length scale = 4000
end
subsection Material model
  subsection Phase field fault
    set Critical energy release rates = 2e7
    # Uniform direct effect avoids unresolved initial-Theta overshoot on this
    # deliberately coarse functional fixture. Production inputs are unchanged.
    set Direct effect parameters = 0.025, 0.025
  end
end
subsection Fault reconstruction
  set Structural point spacing = 2000
end
subsection Postprocess
  set List of postprocessors = reconstructed fault BP3, visualization, particles, reconstructed faults, BP3 output complete, BP3 restored monitor
  subsection BP3
    set Bottom normalization completion file = $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/fixtures/completion.txt
    set Last accepted step = 6
    set Profile time interval = 1
    set Profile slip interval = 0.1
    set Graceful wall seconds = 3600
    set Audit full state every step = false
  end
  subsection BP3 restored monitor
    set Stationary profile file = $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/fixtures/profile.txt
    set Write detailed diagnostics = false
  end
end
subsection Checkpointing
  set Steps between checkpoint = 1
  set Time between checkpoint = 0
end

# R1: matching maintained plugin; omitted map_measurement only observes heap use.
set Additional shared libraries = $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/plugin-build/libbp3_restore_150x50.release.so
subsection Postprocess
  subsection BP3
    set Audit full state every step = true
  end
end
bp3-split.prm:
include $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/inputs/bp3-base.prm
set Output directory = $ASPECT_SOURCE_DIR/benchmarks/reconstructed_fault/refactoring_r1/output-bp3-split
set Resume computation = true
